---
title: "Research"
pagetitle: "Research — Kamil Gacek"
description-meta: "Environmentally extended Input–Output modelling, water footprint analysis and disaster impact assessment for the Polish economy."
page-layout: article
---

My research bridges environmental economics and applied mathematical modelling to assess the
macroeconomic consequences of droughts and other physical disruptions in the Polish economy.
Input–Output frameworks let me examine direct and indirect sectoral water dependencies and
understand how a shortage in one place turns into a cascading economic shock somewhere else.
I work with environmentally extended Input–Output models, structural decomposition and path
analysis, backward and forward linkages, and Dynamic Inoperability Input–Output Models.
